steps: Heat the oil in a kadai and fry the chopped onion until soft and see-through.
Add the garlic and most of the ginger, keeping a few ginger strips aside, and cook for a minute.
Add the chopped tomato and cook until it turns into a thick, glossy paste, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the coriander powder, chilli powder and salt and cook for a minute.
Add the capsicum, green chilli and a splash of water and cook for 3 minutes so the capsicum keeps some crunch.
Add the paneer cubes and garam masala and stir gently for 2 minutes.
Crush the kasuri methi over the top, add the ginger strips and coriander leaves, and serve.
note: All three recipes grind whole coriander seeds and dried red chillies into a kadai masala; here coriander powder and chilli powder stand in for it.
